snippet.title: Mina the Hollower - Demo Release Trailer | State of Play 2026
snippet.description: Use classic weapons like a chain whip, giant hammer, and a whole lot more as the burrowing hero, Mina. Remeniscent of classic retro handheld games, Mina the Hollower comes to PS5 in Spring 2026. A PS5 demo is available on February 13.
